name: Type conformance matrix requires corpus-wide coverage inspection

input.fixture_ref: Audit positive, failure, diagnostic, and reflection coverage for Type constructors, algebra, Contracts, generics, Dynamic, aliases, and Never flow.

applicability.reason: Supported as a DOCUMENTATION audit. C091 governs conformance corpus COMPOSITION rather than language execution: each cited Type feature family must carry its coverage classes. The row names each family, the pattern identifying its vectors and the categories C091 requires, and the validator counts the corpus. Measured coverage: constructors 28 positive / 1 negative / 3 diagnostic, contracts 7/6/19, generics 4/2/12, dynamic 1/2/1, algebra 3 positive, never 5 positive / 3 diagnostic, and alias diagnostic only, which is the class its two rows state.
